children: Almonty received final inspection certificates for Sangdong’s processing and crushing facilities, enabling commercial tungsten concentrate production and sales. Over 90% of Phase I output is covered by a 21-year offtake with GTP.
Removes last regulatory hurdle; enables revenue from concentrate sales.
De-risks marketing; provides visibility on initial cash flows.
Long-duration demand anchor supports financing and operations.
Indicates significant contracted sales over the term.
Sets a floor for annual volumes once ramped, aiding planning.

This is a late-stage milestone shifting Sangdong from commissioning to commercial production with sales largely pre-sold. Next, steady ramp performance, meeting volume specs, and timely deliveries will determine revenue cadence and validate the contract economics.
